title: Stylish & Contemporary 5th floor Condo, Sleeps 10
description:
Stay in a stylish fifth-floor downtown Nashville condo with a private balcony, city views, elevator access, fast Wi-Fi, and an in-building gym. The three-bedroom home sleeps eight with three queen beds and one sofa bed. Enjoy two full bathrooms, a full kitchen, dedicated workspace, and shared laundry access during your Music City stay.

The space
Experience your own sliver of Nashville luxury here at Muse 507, a contemporary condo mere blocks from the heart of downtown. With nods to Dolly Parton and the vibrant music scene throughout, you will have no trouble feeling like a Nashville local from the moment you arrive.

After full days of exploring the city, checking out museums, and getting your fill of the nightlife, simply settle down and enjoy some peace and quiet in the spacious living area as a favorite show streams on the TV. Each bedroom also features its own TV when guests want a bit of privacy. Don't worry about having to head out each evening to pick up dinner, because you have everything you need right at your fingertips in the well-equipped kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, a coffee maker, breakfast bar seating for conversation, and a stunning black tile backsplash. Finish off each night with a cocktail on the balcony to really slip into vacation mode!

There has never been a better time to visit the Music City, so book your stay while this gem lasts!

Shared Amenities・Rooftop lounge・Fitness center・Cornhole court・Elevator in the building

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
